  "overall_experience": "This System Engineer likely found Klaviyo to be a powerful and feature-rich platform, appreciating its robust automation and integration capabilities for managing complex marketing activities. Despite these challenges, its overall functionality and ability to meet technical marketing needs led to a generally positive experience."
